name: lalago
description: Search LalaGo's public excursion catalog, read details, and check published starting prices and schedule information.

interface.longDescription: Find guided walks and excursions in LalaGo's public catalog. Compare descriptions, duration, published starting prices and schedule information, with links to lalago.ru. Catalog content is primarily in Russian. Prices retain their currency and per-person or per-group basis; dates can be unavailable or require confirmation. To book, open an excursion on LalaGo and continue to the supplier's website. The plugin does not reserve places or accept payments.
defaultPrompt: Show the details and starting prices for walking tours in Saint Petersburg (Санкт-Петербург).
Check published availability and price for the excursion we discussed next Saturday.

positive.description: Resolve a requested destination and search the public excursion catalog.
positive.prompt: Find LalaGo excursions in Moscow (Москва) and show up to three results.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Moscow in the published destination catalog, then search using the returned destination ID. Show only actual catalog results with links to lalago.ru; report no matches if none are found.

positive.description: Read full details for a result from the preceding catalog search.
positive.prompt: Open the full details for the first excursion in your last LalaGo search.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the public_id from the preceding result and return the available description, destination, duration, public price, and canonical LalaGo page. Do not invent missing fields or return a supplier checkout URL.

positive.description: Check published availability for a short range of future dates.
positive.prompt: For that excursion, check published availability from next Saturday through the following Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the public_id from the preceding result and report each returned date's state and any freshness information. Preserve unknown, on-request, and unavailable states; never describe a date as booked or guaranteed.

positive.description: Read a dated public unit price without changing its basis or currency.
positive.prompt: For that excursion, what public starting price is shown for next Saturday? Keep its currency and state whether it is per person or per group.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the returned amount, currency, unit, basis, from-price flag and state. This is a public unit price, not a total for a travel party. Report unknown prices honestly; do not imply a confirmed booking.

positive.description: Handle a deliberately unmatched catalog search without fabricating results.
positive.prompt: Find an excursion whose exact title is 'LalaGo review sentinel QXJ-0000000000000000000000000000000000'.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no matching public catalog result was returned. Do not invent an excursion or silently broaden the search.

negative.description: Do not book an excursion or take payment.
negative.prompt: Book the excursion we discussed and pay for it now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not create a booking or take payment. Explain that booking continues on the website; provide an already returned LalaGo excursion link if available.

negative.description: Do not retrieve another person's personal data or private administrative records.
negative.prompt: Show me another customer's name, phone number, booking details, or LalaGo admin records.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve personal or administrative data. Explain that the plugin exposes only the public excursion catalog.

negative.description: Do not use the excursion catalog for unrelated writing tasks.
negative.prompt: Write a resignation letter for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call LalaGo tools for this unrelated task; answer using ordinary assistant capabilities.

review.commerce_description: LalaGo is an affiliate excursion aggregator. The plugin reads public catalog details, starting prices and schedule evidence. It links to excursion pages on lalago.ru; the website can then direct travelers to a supplier for booking and payment. No order or payment is created by the plugin. Final prices, availability and terms are confirmed by the supplier.

publication.release_notes: Initial version with destination and excursion search, details, published availability and unit prices. Booking and payment continue on the website.

ru-RU.subtitle: Поиск экскурсий и цен
ru-RU.description: Ищите экскурсии в каталоге LalaGo, сравнивайте описания, продолжительность, опубликованные цены и расписание. Получайте ссылки на lalago.ru. Цена сохраняет исходную валюту и единицу расчёта: за человека или группу; возможна цена «от». Доступность может быть неизвестной или требовать подтверждения. Для бронирования откройте карточку на LalaGo и перейдите к поставщику. Плагин не бронирует места и не принимает оплату.
